paper.title: GeoVLA: Empowering 3D Representations in Vision-Language-Action Models

claim: 当前VLA模型依赖2D视觉输入，忽略了丰富的3D几何信息，限制了空间感知能力，这是具身操作中allocentric表征缺失的核心瓶颈。

paper.title: GeoVLA: Empowering 3D Representations in Vision-Language-Action Models

claim: GeoVLA将深度图转换为点云，通过Point Embedding Network生成3D几何嵌入，与VLM视觉-语言嵌入拼接后由3D增强Action Expert处理，在LIBERO和ManiSkill2上达到SOTA。

paper.title: GeoVLA: Empowering 3D Representations in Vision-Language-Action Models

claim: 3D几何表征的引入使模型在高度适应性（height adaptability）、尺度感知（scale awareness）和视角不变性（viewpoint invariance）方面表现出鲁棒性，验证了allocentric 3D表征对泛化的关键作用。

paper.title: SpatialActor: Exploring Disentangled Spatial Representations for Robust Robotic Manipulation

claim: 基于点的方法因稀疏采样丢失细粒度语义，基于图像的方法将语义与几何纠缠在一起，对深度噪声敏感——两种主流allocentric表征路径各有结构性缺陷。

paper.title: SpatialActor: Exploring Disentangled Spatial Representations for Robust Robotic Manipulation

claim: SpatialActor提出Semantic-guided Geometric Module，融合噪声深度与语义引导专家先验，并用Spatial Transformer利用低层空间线索实现2D-3D映射，在RLBench上达87.4%，噪声条件下提升13.9-19.4%。
locator: Sec 3-4; Table RLBench results + noise robustness

paper.title: SpatialActor: Exploring Disentangled Spatial Representations for Robust Robotic Manipulation

claim: 解耦语义与几何的allocentric表征显著增强少样本泛化能力，表明allocentric表征的质量而非数量是泛化的关键。

paper.title: Spatial Forcing: Implicit Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-language-action Model

claim: 显式3D传感器面临传感器噪声、硬件异构性、深度覆盖不完整等问题；2D-to-3D估计则受限于深度估计器性能——显式allocentric 3D输入路径存在工程瓶颈。

paper.title: Spatial Forcing: Implicit Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-language-action Model

claim: Spatial Forcing无需显式3D输入，通过将中间视觉嵌入与预训练3D基础模型表征对齐（隐式空间表征对齐），超越2D和3D-based VLA，并实现3.8倍训练加速。
locator: Sec 3-4; Table main results + training efficiency

paper.title: Spatial Forcing: Implicit Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-language-action Model

claim: 隐式空间表征对齐为allocentric 3D理解提供了一条无需额外传感器硬件的实用路径，降低了3D表征的部署门槛。
locator: Sec 5 Discussion, inferred from implicit alignment design

paper.title: OmniManip: Towards General Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric Interaction Primitives as Spatial Constraints

claim: VLM缺乏细粒度3D空间理解能力，无法直接支撑精确操作——这是allocentric表征从推理到执行的核心鸿沟。

paper.title: OmniManip: Towards General Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric Interaction Primitives as Spatial Constraints

claim: OmniManip以物体功能可供性定义的canonical space（object-centric allocentric空间）为基础，将交互原语（点、方向）作为空间约束，实现零样本泛化且无需VLM微调。

paper.title: OmniManip: Towards General Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric Interaction Primitives as Spatial Constraints

claim: 双闭环架构（高层规划通过原语重采样 + 低层执行通过6D位姿跟踪）确保了allocentric空间约束从抽象推理到物理执行的精确落地。

paper.title: 3D-VLA: A 3D Vision-Language-Action Generative World Model

claim: 依赖2D输入的VLA缺乏3D物理世界整合，忽略世界动态——allocentric 3D表征是连接感知、推理与动作的基础设施。

paper.title: 3D-VLA: A 3D Vision-Language-Action Generative World Model

claim: 3D-VLA基于3D LLM构建，引入交互token，使用embodied diffusion模型预测目标图像和点云，将3D感知、推理与动作链接为统一的世界模型，并构建了大规模3D具身指令数据集。

paper.title: 3D Diffusion Policy: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning via Simple 3D Representations

claim: DP3通过稀疏点云的点编码器构建紧凑3D视觉表征，集成到diffusion policy中，证明了3D表征相比2D方法的泛化优势——为后续allocentric 3D表征工作奠定了基础。

paper.title: SpatialVLM: Endowing Vision-Language Models with Spatial Reasoning Capabilities

claim: SpatialVLM通过链式空间推理和互联网规模空间数据预训练，使VLM具备距离、尺寸、关系理解等空间推理能力——为VLM中allocentric空间推理奠定基础。

paper.title: SpatialVLM: Endowing Vision-Language Models with Spatial Reasoning Capabilities

claim: VLM原生空间推理能力不足，需要显式的空间数据预训练和推理链设计才能支撑allocentric级别的空间理解。

paper.title: SpatialRGPT: Grounded Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

claim: SpatialRGPT通过深度感知视觉编码器和区域级空间推理两项创新，增强VLM在室内、室外、仿真环境中的空间感知与推理能力，并构建了SpatialRGPT-Bench基准。

paper.title: Keep it SymPL: Symbolic Projective Layout for Allocentric Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

claim: VLM在egocentric（自我中心）空间推理上表现良好，但在allocentric（物体中心）视角下表现很差——allocentric空间推理是VLM的核心短板。
locator: Sec 1 Introduction; ego vs allocentric analysis

paper.title: Keep it SymPL: Symbolic Projective Layout for Allocentric Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

claim: SymPL通过四步流程（Projection 3D→2D、Abstraction 物体→符号、Bisection 空间分区、Localization）实现免训练allocentric推理，在COMFORT#上left/right 69%、closer 97.33%、visibility 91.41%、facing 91.50%。
locator: Sec 3 Method; Sec 4 Results on COMFORT#

paper.title: Keep it SymPL: Symbolic Projective Layout for Allocentric Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

claim: SymPL的性能依赖于VLM方向感知的准确性，当VLM对物体朝向判断错误时allocentric推理会级联失败——这是符号化方法的固有依赖。

paper.title: Grounded Chain-of-Thought for Multimodal Large Language Models

claim: VLM空间推理存在幻觉问题：模型能给出正确答案但推理过程是幻觉生成的，'答案正确=推理正确'的假设不成立——allocentric空间推理的可信度存疑。

paper.title: Grounded Chain-of-Thought for Multimodal Large Language Models

claim: 在对抗性测试下，所有模型Grounding-Acc <5%、Consistency <5%；LLaVA-13B最高Answer-Acc 69.7%但Consistency仅13.3%——VLM的allocentric空间推理在对抗条件下接近崩溃。

paper.title: HandVQA: Diagnosing and Improving Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning about Hands in Vision-Language Models

claim: 基础VLM在角度和距离等细粒度空间推理上接近随机猜测水平，表明allocentric级别的精细3D空间理解远未解决。

paper.title: HandVQA: Diagnosing and Improving Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning about Hands in Vision-Language Models

claim: 通过微调，相对位置准确率从约50%提升至90%以上，且空间知识可迁移到下游任务——3D allocentric空间推理是可学习的，但需要针对性训练。
locator: Sec 5 Fine-tuning results and transfer experiments

paper.title: Geometrically-Constrained Agent for Spatial Reasoning

claim: VLM在有损语义空间中推理，与几何计算不匹配——allocentric空间推理需要将语义推理与几何计算解耦。

paper.title: Geometrically-Constrained Agent for Spatial Reasoning

claim: GCA将VLM解耦为语义分析器和任务求解器，形式化任务约束（参考系+目标约束），工具箱含检测、朝向估计、分割、3D重建、BEV分析，通过知识增强代码生成实现几何约束的空间推理。
locator: Sec 3 Method; tool box and code generation

paper.title: ActiveVLA: Injecting Active Perception into Vision-Language-Action Models for Precise 3D Robotic Manipulation

claim: 将主动感知注入VLA使机器人能主动调整视角以获取更好的3D理解，从而提升3D操作精度——allocentric表征的质量可通过主动感知动态提升。

paper.title: ActiveVLA: Injecting Active Perception into Vision-Language-Action Models for Precise 3D Robotic Manipulation

claim: 被动感知下的allocentric 3D表征受限于单一视角，主动视角调整是突破视角不变性瓶颈的有效路径。
locator: Inferred from active perception design rationale

paper.title: Thinking in Space: How Multimodal Large Language Models Learn to Reason Spatially Through Video

claim: VSI-Bench将ego-allocentric转换（自我中心与物体中心视角转换）作为评估MLLM空间智能的关键维度，测试显示MLLM尚未达到人类水平空间智能。

paper.title: Thinking in Space: How Multimodal Large Language Models Learn to Reason Spatially Through Video

claim: ego-allocentric转换能力是空间智能的核心组成部分，当前MLLM在此维度上的差距表明allocentric表征不是边缘问题而是基础能力缺口。

paper.title: Multimodal Spatial Reasoning in the Large Model Era: A Survey and Benchmarks

claim: 该综述系统梳理了空间推理的任务、基准和方法，明确将allocentric空间推理识别为大模型时代的关键挑战。

paper.title: Multimodal Spatial Reasoning in the Large Model Era: A Survey and Benchmarks

claim: 当前空间推理方法在egocentric任务上进展显著，但allocentric视角的推理仍是系统性短板，缺乏统一的表征框架。

paper.title: Ego2Robot: Scalable Robot Data Synthesis from Egocentric Human Data

claim: Ego2Robot将1,940小时egocentric视频通过动作对齐转换为机器人训练数据，其中3D空间对齐是ego-to-robot迁移的关键——allocentric表征在跨 embodiment 数据迁移中起桥梁作用。
locator: Method: action alignment and 3D spatial alignment

paper.title: Ego2Robot: Scalable Robot Data Synthesis from Egocentric Human Data

claim: 从平行夹爪到多指手的retargeting需要精确的3D空间对齐，allocentric表征为跨embodiment迁移提供了坐标系无关的中间表示。

paper.title: A Survey of Embodied Learning for Object-centric Robotic Manipulation

claim: 该综述系统回顾了机器人操作中object-centric（allocentric）表征方法，覆盖感知、学习和控制——allocentric表征在具身操作中已有系统性研究脉络。

paper.title: A Survey of Embodied Learning for Object-centric Robotic Manipulation

claim: object-centric表征在泛化性和可组合性上优势明显，但与端到端VLA的集成仍处于早期阶段——allocentric表征与大规模预训练的融合是未解问题。

paper.title: GeoVLA: Empowering 3D Representations in Vision-Language-Action Models

claim: allocentric 3D表征的引入不仅提升绝对性能，更在视角变化和尺度变化下保持稳定，说明allocentric表征编码了视角无关的几何不变性。
locator: Inferred from viewpoint invariance and scale awareness results

paper.title: SpatialActor: Exploring Disentangled Spatial Representations for Robust Robotic Manipulation

claim: 语义-几何解耦的allocentric表征在噪声条件下优势放大（+13.9-19.4%），说明allocentric表征的鲁棒性来源于表征解耦而非简单的信息增加。
locator: Inferred from noise robustness vs clean performance gap

paper.title: Spatial Forcing: Implicit Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-language-action Model

claim: 隐式对齐3D基础模型表征即可超越显式3D输入方法，说明allocentric 3D理解的关键在于表征空间的对齐质量而非传感器数据的直接注入。
locator: Inferred from implicit vs explicit 3D comparison

paper.title: OmniManip: Towards General Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric Interaction Primitives as Spatial Constraints

claim: object-centric canonical space以功能可供性定义，使allocentric表征天然携带任务语义——这是allocentric表征区别于纯几何3D表征的关键优势。
locator: Inferred from affordance-defined canonical space design

paper.title: Keep it SymPL: Symbolic Projective Layout for Allocentric Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

claim: 通过投影和符号化将3D allocentric推理降维为2D符号操作，是一种以计算效率换取表征保真度的折中策略。

paper.title: Grounded Chain-of-Thought for Multimodal Large Language Models

claim: 三种范式（Answer-First、Grounding-First、Grounded CoT）的对比表明，先grounding再推理的Grounded CoT范式在缓解allocentric空间推理幻觉上最有效。
